pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Nbd7 11.Bf4 Qe7
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1 with a rook on f1; plan 4 sent the d7-knight to f8 (rook there). Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Classical Variation, Argentine Counterattack
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin on f3 (the e2-bishop stands behind); plan 2 broke the "pin" with g4 onto the bishop. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Bg4 11.Bf4 Bxf3
pages.notes: Overview called the g4-bishop dark-squared and had ...Bxf3 damaging White's structure; plan 1 used a ...Ne8-d7-f8 route; plan 4 played Nh4-f5 with no knight. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2, 4 (reviewer: f2-f4 blocked by the f4-bishop; gxf3 does not keep more pieces).

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Bg4 11.Bf4 Bxf3 12.Bxf3 Qe7
pages.notes: Overview had Black trading the dark-squared bishop; plan 3 moved the f3-bishop to c2 or d1. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3 (reviewer: a4 already played; the long diagonal is blocked by d5 after e4-e5).

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Bg4 11.Bf4 Bxf3 12.Bxf3 Qe7 13.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 2 used a ...Nbd7-e8 route. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Bg4 11.Bf4 Re8 12.Nd2 Bxe2 13.Qxe2 Nh5
pages.notes: Overview said Black traded the fianchettoed bishop (it was the light-squared one); plan 4 put the h5-knight on f4 or g7, both occupied, then called ...Nxf4 an exchange of a hanging bishop (reviewer catch). Rewrote overview and plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, 9.O-O a6 10.a4 Bg4 11.Nd2
pages.notes: Overview had Nd2 neutralising a pin on f3; plan 2 used ...Nf8-e6 with a rook on f8. Rewrote overview phrase and plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Classical Variation, Czerniak Defense
pages.notes: Overview and plans 1 and 3 relied on a ...e5 break with no Black e-pawn. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Qc2 Na6
pages.notes: Plan 1 relied on f4 and a White bishop pair; plan 4 rerouted ...Nbd7-c7 with the knight on a6. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Classical, Main Line, 10.Qc2 Na6 11.Bf4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4 with the bishop on f4; plan 3 rerouted Nd2-f1-e3 with a rook on f1. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.
